evidence: Reading through the middle of the main body (col 8), rows 3-7 form a 5-row foreshortened elliptical top cap (row 3 bright orange-tan #d89448 back rim, row 4 #b87444, row 5 #a46c48, row 6 #b87444 ring highlight, row 7 #a46c48 front rim). At row 8 the surface steps down to a darker reddish-brown (#985838) vertical front face that runs 7 rows (rows 8-14) with dark brown cylindrical side shadows (#603010, #482408) tucked under the wider bark rim at row 6.

style.evidence: The chopping block uses the same 6-step warm wood ramp as the Beodeul reference stall and well roof (bright orange-tan rim highlight, light tan, mid tan, reddish mid-brown, dark brown, and deep brown/black grounding at the lower sides), plus a 2-step metal ramp on the cleaver. The top face shows concentric ring shading and the vertical trunk carries two-tone cylindrical shading and diagonal grain dots matching the reference wood panels, with ~10 distinct colours in a single 16x16 tile and no flat fills.
